release_lanes.name: release-truth
acceptance: Record v0.17.0 as shipped public beta and keep DAP preview.
Correct README, installation, status, release history, v0.17.0 frontmatter, and generators that can restore alpha wording.
Record each observed channel as VERIFIED, PARTIAL, or NOT_PROVEN.
Do not stage v0.18 notes, versions, lockfiles, or pending history rows.
proof: Repository status generator/check and docs path/link validation.

release_lanes.name: release-workflow
acceptance: Remove duplicate release-published feedback paths and retain one orchestration authority.
Pin Rust and tooling versions; build and validate every archive.
Generate consolidated checksums and fail-closed SPDX SBOM output.
Define and attest the complete subject set before GitHub Release publication.
Use curated notes as sole release prose.
Use named protected publishing environments and least privilege.
proof: Workflow contract tests plus actionlint and zizmor.
No-publish candidate rehearsal proves ordering, artifacts, checksums, SBOM, subjects, notes, and permissions.

release_lanes.name: release-lineage
acceptance: Decide which perl-lsp-unique tests return to swarm.
Decide whether the swarm DAP dispatcher remains canonical.
Name release-repo-only lineage exclusions.
Account for any product behavior that remains unmirrored.
Promote a complete frozen swarm tree without per-file blending.
proof: Disposition receipt links each decision to exact SHAs.
Complete-tree equality proof succeeds outside named exclusions.

release_lanes.name: installed-acceptance
acceptance: Install packaged perllsp, perl-dap, and VSIX into isolated prefix and VS Code profile roots.
Fail if any workspace binary executes; bind exact SHA and artifact hashes.

Exercise version, doctor, health, initialization, readiness, diagnostics, completion, hover, definition, references, symbols, edit/requery, rename or safe refusal, formatting, stale-index eviction, DAP smoke, and shutdown.
Require false exact, stale exact, unsafe edits, unexplained empty, wrong artifact, unbounded fallback, and protocol crash counts all equal zero.
proof: Durable receipt binds exact SHA, artifact hashes, resolved executable paths, journey results, and invariant counts.
Receipt is regenerated after the last product mutation and consumed by the no-publish candidate rehearsal.

classification_method.base_and_ancestry: Each row records the live head and base ref. Head-to-observation ancestry is NOT_PROVEN unless a row proof says otherwise; excluded work is not promoted on inferred freshness.
classification_method.work_id: The controlling_issue is the Work-ID when present. Null is explicit and requires a builder-ready follow-up before revival.
classification_method.user_outcome: Paths, relationship, and rationale state the user-facing or control-plane outcome used for disposition.
classification_method.current_main: Only the completed correctness band was re-proved on current main. Other product changes are not reproduced and remain excluded unless packaged acceptance exposes a blocker.
classification_method.proof_strength: Checks and unresolved-thread counts are exact-head GitHub observations where available; null and unknown values are preserved.
classification_method.missing_controls: A deferred PR needs current-main reproduction, exact-head terminal checks, negative controls, and resolved review threads before revival.
classification_method.release_value: Admission is limited to honest release truth, mechanics, lineage, installed proof, and one demonstrated product blocker.
classification_method.regression_risk: Unadmitted product, parser, performance, refactor, and control-plane mutations can invalidate acceptance and are deferred.
classification_method.proof_cost: Deep proof is paid only for admitted lanes; deferred PRs retain their issue and current observation for post-release work.
classification_method.rollback: Admission-only changes can be reverted before final freeze; any product mutation after acceptance invalidates the receipt and requires a full rerun.

known_limitations: This is an admission observation, not a final SHA freeze.
Schema version 1 intentionally cannot represent final-frozen; final freeze requires a versioned schema/checker that binds frozen, lineage, and installed-acceptance SHAs and receipt hashes.
Unknown or unexpanded check and mergeability values remain explicit instead of being inferred.
PRs opened after observed_at_utc default to post-0.18 unless separately admitted as a demonstrated release blocker; they do not expand this bounded snapshot.
Superseded classifications require separate close-proof before any PR is closed.
No-semicolon qw recovery, broader statement starters, and shared delimiter-scanner refactoring remain tracked in #4491, #4494, #4495, and #4499.
claim_boundary: This receipt classifies the open PR queue at one current-main observation SHA and activates an admission freeze. It is not the final frozen SHA, release readiness, merge authorization, a version bump, a tag, publication, deployment, or channel mutation.
